issues.where: spring landing and settle, frames 174–289 (2.90–4.82 s)
issues.what: The moss base and pink light announce spring, but the opaque pink cloud still hides the cottage and flowering tree for nearly two seconds after landing. The physical payoff and the seasonal reveal land as separate beats.
issues.fix: Keep the dense swirl through the swap, then open a clear pocket around the cottage and flowering canopy on landing while petals continue drifting around the glass.
